  8. PRNewswire · Jun 21, 2026 · Vendor release

    Honeycomb announced the publication of Observability Engineering: Achieving Production Excellence, 2nd Edition, co-authored by Charity Majors, Liz Fong-Jones, George Miranda, and Austin Parker.
